summary: First iteration. Wrote backend pytest suite (21 tests, 100% pass) covering health, prompts, auth, games CRUD, full submit+score+auto-advance flow, leaderboard, profile, admin (role gating + prompt CRUD), and WebSocket. Wrote Playwright frontend script (all critical flows pass): Landing, unauth redirects for 6 protected routes, authed Dashboard (4 stat tiles), Lobby create-game -> GameRoom navigation, GameRoom lobby view with Start button for host, Leaderboard, Admin (stats+users+prompts visible), Profile. WebSocket connects from backend test successfully.

minor.issue: Returns 401 for invalid id (expected); but on httpx network error returns 502 - acceptable but document.
Public/unauthenticated access allowed (any game can be fetched by id without auth). Consider whether private games should require auth.
Dialogue check accepts a single apostrophe (e.g. "don't") which would satisfy duel dialogue rule even without real dialogue. Consider stricter check.

integration_issues.issue: Console warning 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' fires on navigation/quick mount-unmount. Benign during navigation but consider cleanup on unmount.

action_items: Optional: tighten duel dialogue validation in submit_writing (accept only " or curly quotes, not bare apostrophes).
Optional: decide if GET /api/games/{id} should require auth for private games.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py create_session: hardcoded EMERGENT_AUTH_URL is fine per design comment, but cookie is set with secure=True+samesite=none which requires HTTPS – good for prod, will not work on bare http localhost (not an issue in this preview).

game_routes._maybe_advance_round mutates game['rounds'] in place after fetching a snapshot - mostly fine since handler is single-flight per request, but concurrent score requests could race (no transaction). Consider using $inc/find_one_and_update for score_count and atomic flag to flip 'completed'.
submit_writing duel dialogue check `"'" in text` matches apostrophes inside words – overly permissive.
ws endpoint sends 'ack' on every message but never validates JSON payload type; clients send raw strings. OK for MVP.
Frontend AuthContext: synchronous hash check for OAuth callback path is correct; loading=false set early - good.
All endpoints already exclude _id via {'_id': 0} projection. Good.
test_credentials: Created in MongoDB: user_id=test-fe-user-02b7ed37 token=test_fe_session_521e1da111734a3ca42d496f5b0c17d0 (admin role). Other test users are created per-test via fixtures and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Test users + sessions created directly in MongoDB via pytest fixtures with teardown. Test games/submissions/scores cleaned up at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical APIs incl. full game flow with auto-advance. WebSocket test uses websockets package over wss. Frontend authed flows can be tested by adding a session_token cookie to playwright context after seeding user_sessions in mongo. Admin page renders fine. OpenRouter AI prompt endpoint returning 503 is expected (no API key).
rca of the issue: No issues found. All 21 backend tests pass, all 8 frontend flows pass.
